Our flagship brand is Rejuvacare, with RejuvaKnee as our hero product in chronic pain relief, and we are actively launching new brands across the portfolio. We run entirely on paid digital channels, ship primarily into the United States, and have grown twelve times in a single year with close to 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote-first by design and async-first by default. The Role Every funnel we publish carries paid traffic from the moment it goes live. When something breaks here, it does not break quietly in a staging environment. It breaks while we are spending money on it. The expensive failures in this business are rarely the obvious ones. A page that looks perfect but records the order under the wrong offer. An upsell that charges correctly and then sends the customer to a blank screen. A purchase event that fires twice and quietly corrupts the numbers the media buyer is optimizing against. A downsell path nobody walked, because everybody tested the version where the customer says yes. We are hiring a Funnel QA Specialist to be the person who walks those paths. You will test complete customer journeys rather than pages, inside Checkout Champ and across the funnels built on top of it. You will place test orders, follow every branch including the ones where the customer declines, verify that tracking fires correctly and only once, check the experience on mobile first because that is where our traffic is, and confirm that what went live matches what was approved. And you will do the part that matters more than any individual bug: when the same defect appears for the third time, you stop logging it as a new ticket and change the thing that keeps producing it.
